text:
alex (product): Quick sync — finalizing retention tiers + BYOK launch criteria. Need concise DO/DO NOTs and decisions by EOD Friday.
jaoanna (security): +1. High-level checklist: retention tiers, BYOK handshake & test vector, signed export manifests, and immutable legal-hold flow.
nate (infra): For Dedicated/Private: per-tenant configurable retention window + default. Note: backups and cross-region replication add retention cost.
priya (legal): Must include legal-hold override, immutable exports for eDiscovery, and an auditable retention-change trail (who/when/reason).
liam (eng): Implementation sketch: model retention as dataset-level SLO. Config example:
```
retention:
  tier: "90"
  immutable: false
  hold_until: null
  kms_key_id: "projects/.../keys/..."
```
jaoanna (security): BYOK requirements: support customer-managed KMS (AWS/Google/Azure), never persist plaintext customer keys, provide a handshake + proof-of-possession step, and document rotation expectations.
alex (product): Proposed launch criteria:
- UI: choose retention tier + toggle immutability/legal-hold
- BYOK onboarding: handshake + test vector validation
- Audit exports: ndjson + parquet outputs with per-file checksums and signed manifest
- Update SOC2 evidence and run internal audit
nate (infra): Ops acceptance: tenant-level retention dashboard, nightly export verification job, alerts if checksum failures >= 3.
priya (legal): Contract changes: retention SLA + 30-day notification before auto-deletion/archival; LOA required for any key-escrow requests.
liam (eng): Edge cases:
- Migrating customers with mixed historical retention
- KMS unreachable -> explicit opt-in fallback to short-lived encrypted store
- Embedding replay requires cache invalidation; include migration playbook
jaoanna (security): Risks: customer requests for escrow, lost customer keys, crypto algorithm upgrades. Escrow only with signed contract + indemnity.
ops-bot: RFC posted: /docs/rfcs/rfc-xxxxx retention + byok prototype (https://redwood/docs/rfc/xxxxx)
alex (product): Decision points by EOD Fri:
1) Default tiers to expose (pick 3)
2) Offer vendor-managed escrow as paid add-on? (yes/no)
3) Minimal export formats (ndjson, parquet, both?)
liam (eng): My votes: defaults = 30/90/365; archival as custom enterprise option. Escrow = opt-in paid add-on. Export = ndjson + parquet.
priya (legal): Agree on 30/90/365. Escrow needs contract language + indemnity + LOA.
jaoanna (security): Require BYOK test vector at onboarding: customer encrypts token we verify; only store wrapped key metadata and audit log.
alex (product): Action items + owners:
- Priya: legal-hold + escrow wording + LOA template (due Tue)
- Jaoanna: BYOK acceptance tests, failure modes doc (due Mon)
- Liam + Nate: infra scope, migration playbook, PR checklist (due Wed)
- Alex: roadmap update + pricing tier writeup (due Thu)
liam (eng): I'll draft migration playbook for >1yr-retention customers to avoid accidental deletion.
nate (infra): I'll prototype nightly verification job and add SLO panels to dashboard.
priya (legal): I'll include 30-day notification clause and LOA template in the draft.
jaoanna (security): Note for auditors: exports must include signed manifest, per-file checksum, and manifest signature for immutability proof.
alex (product): If no objections I'll lock into compliance epic and schedule kickoff Fri 11:00am PT.
liam (eng): :+1:
priya (legal): :thumbsup:
jaoanna (security): :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: reminder set: kickoff meeting Fri 11:00am PT
